هُوَ أَتْوَهُ النَّاسِ He is the most extraordinary of men [in deviating from, or losing, or missing, the right way; in losing his way: or] in confusion, or perplexity, and inability to see his right course: as also أَتَيْهُ الناس: but the former is more common. (TA.) ―
-b2- [It may also mean He is the proudest, or vainest, of men.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
